_comment: The rare early-game materials sit at diamond (Jonah, 2026-09-06): rarity is the point of them, and a pickaxe is the one gate that is legible before you know what the stuff is for. Scorched temperstone is deliberately absent — it is the spoiled band, netherrack-soft on purpose, and it carries no requiresCorrectToolForDrops for the tier to bite on.
